actions.action: Lift nursery pot out of ceramic pot and check for standing water
Push finger 5 cm into soil to check moisture (recheck every 3-4 days)
If dry, water slowly until it drains, then empty ceramic pot after 15 minutes
If wet or water pooled, pour out the water and wait until top 5 cm is dry before watering
Move palm to 1-2 m from the big window in bright indirect light
Monitor new fronds over the next 1-2 months

reason: The answer blames move stress and watering as the main cause and treats the dim corner only as a secondary factor, though it does include moving the palm to brighter light, which was the confirmed fix; the watering checks are safeguarded and not harmful.
